annotations.title: Save the guest board after account sign-in

description: Transfers an existing guest board to the connected account using its original guestToken. An empty guest session has nothing to transfer; continue with the connected account without guestToken. Requires account authorization and an idle board. The transfer preserves the design, returns a new account board ID and retires guest access. Within 24 hours, repeating a successful claim with the same token and account returns the existing account board ID while that board remains owned by the account and available.

guestToken.description: Private guest-session capability returned by start_guest_session. Never print it or save it in a repository.

name: claim_guest_board
